dublinCore.dc:rights: Pursuant to Title 17 Section 105 of the United States Code, this file is not subject to copyright protection and is in the public domain.

form.official-title: To amend the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2023 to extend the time period for which certain regulations concerning the North Atlantic right whale are effective.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Northeast Lobsterman Protection Act of 2026.

section.header: Extension of effectiveness of certain regulations concerning North Atlantic right whale
section.text: Section 101 of division JJ of the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2023 (16 U.S.C. 1387 note) is amended by striking 2028 each place it appears and inserting 2035.

attestation-group.attestation-date: Passed the House of Representatives September 1, 2026.
